help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How to use the app — short and simple.
help.worker_1: Open “Search” at the bottom, choose “I'm looking for a job”, then pick a profession and region.
help.worker_2: Open a matching listing: get in touch right away with “Call” or tap “Apply”.
help.worker_3: If you see “Application sent”, the employer has received it.
help.worker_4: On the home page tap “Post about myself” — employers will find you in search.
help.worker_5: Replies appear in “My account” → “My applications” and “Job offers”; updates in “Notifications”.
help.employer_1: On the home page tap “Post a job”.
help.employer_2: Choose the profession (not on the list? type it in), then fill in the region and terms step by step.
help.employer_3: Review the listing and tap “Publish listing”.
help.employer_4: In “My account”, the listing card shows the number of applications and “Matching workers”.
help.employer_5: Open an application: reply with “Shortlist” or “Reject”, get in touch via “Message” or “Call”.
help.safety_1: Never send money to anyone to get a job.
help.safety_2: Your phone number is visible only to employers you allow.
help.safety_3: See a suspicious listing or message? Tap “Report”.
help.report_hint: Every job and profile page has a “Report” button.

market.meta_title: Ish topdim — find jobs and hire staff in Uzbekistan
market.meta_description: Search vacancies across Uzbekistan, find a job that fits your profession or the employee you need. Ish topdim makes finding work and workers easy.

market.trust_salary_desc: The amount and pay period (monthly or daily) are shown in the listing.
market.trust_contact_desc: Call, apply or message in the app — the way the listing owner allows.

market.emp_b2: Find candidates by profession and location
market.emp_b4: Easy contact with candidates: applications and messages

market.why_simple_desc: Browse without signing up and sign in without a password — the code comes via Telegram.
market.why_trust_desc: Listing checks, reporting, and a badge for employers with verified documents.
market.stats_note: Numbers come from the database and refresh about every 10 minutes.

market.mission_text: Finding work and workers should be easy: clear pay, exact location and direct contact. We don't guarantee a job — we make searching convenient and transparent.
market.footer_about: A platform for job seekers and employers across Uzbekistan.
market.ai_title: Write in plain words — the AI assistant finds it
market.ai_desc: Job, area, pay or “daily” — write the way you speak. The assistant shows what it understood and lists only real listings from the database.
market.ai_point_1: Understands Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic) and Russian
market.ai_point_2: Narrow down in one tap: daily, no experience, remote
market.ai_sample_answer: I'll show matching listings right here — narrow it down with “no experience” if you like.

about.title: About us
about.lead: Ish topdim connects job seekers and employers across Uzbekistan — for every profession, from office staff to tradespeople, drivers and couriers.
about.what_1: Vacancies and worker profiles: permanent, daily, remote and other kinds of work.
about.what_2: Search by profession and location — down to the district.
about.what_3: Direct contact: calls, applications and in-app messages.
about.what_4: Password-free sign-in and notifications via Telegram.
about.trust_1: Every listing is checked automatically before it goes live; doubtful ones are reviewed by a moderator.
about.trust_2: The “Verified” badge appears only for employers whose documents were checked.
about.trust_3: Phone numbers are shown only with the owner's permission.
about.honest_1: We don't guarantee a job or a candidate — we make searching convenient and transparent.
about.honest_2: Hiring terms are agreed between the employer and the candidate.
about.honest_3: Beware of listings that ask for money to get a job, and report them.
about.contact_help: Questions and guides are in the help centre.
